jobs.title: Project Manager (Growth)
jobs.description:
Salmon
is a technology-driven financial company building a banking and lending platform across Southeast Asia, starting in the Philippines.

7M+ app downloads. 2M+ monthly active users. 7000+ partner stores. US$350M+ raised from top-tier investors.

Here, you get real ownership from day one, high standards, and direct communication. You'll work alongside a team that combines deep local knowledge and experience scaling regulated financial companies from scratch.

If you want to solve complex problems at scale and directly impact how millions of people access and manage money, come build with us.

Southeast Asia's fintech moment starts here.

About The Role

We are looking for a Project Manager to take ownership of the end-to-end process of launching marketing communications - from the initial request to campaign dispatch.

The role is focused on stakeholder communication, requirements formalization, execution coordination, quality control, and continuous improvement of the campaign workflow.

What You'll Own

Manage marketing campaigns end-to-end — from request intake to launch.
Work with internal stakeholders to gather, clarify, and formalize requirements.
Translate business requests into clear tasks, priorities, and timelines.
Coordinate execution across teams and keep launches on track.
Ensure campaign quality and help reduce errors and rework.
Improve the campaign workflow through better processes, templates, and checklists.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

3+ years in Project Management or a similar role.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple moving parts.
Ability to structure ambiguous requests and drive them to completion.
Comfortable working in a fast-moving, tech environment.
English at B2 level or higher.
Fluent Russian - this is a must-have requirement.
Currently based outside Russia and Belarus.

Nice to have

Basic SQL or experience working closely with analytics/technical teams.
Experience in marketing, CRM, or customer communications.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Exterior Signage
jobs.description:
Ideal Candidate will have previous experience in the Signage Industry

There’s never been a better time to join Stratus! As the market leader in brand implementation and maintenance, we transform how national brands connect with their customers. From exterior signage & interior branding to site refresh & remodel, from energy & lighting to repair & maintenance solutions, we deliver ideal solutions to meet all our client's branding needs.

From our locations across the country, to our corporate headquarters in Mentor, Ohio, every employee is a stakeholder in Stratus’ success. This environment offers endless career opportunities for individuals with a commitment to customer service, focus on execution and bias for action.

Job Summary:
The Project Manager supports the Account Manager by developing and implementing comprehensive project plans for sign design, manufacturing, and installation, while meeting budget and gross margin targets. This role collaborates closely with internal departments—such as Art, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Production Control—to ensure projects are executed accurately, efficiently, and on schedule. Additionally, the Project Manager selects and manages subcontractors, negotiates pricing, oversees installation quality, and prepares final billing packages for approval.

Responsibilities

Project Development

Attend initial customer meetings alongside sales and Account Management teams to clarify location requirements, product specifications, design considerations, and preliminary surveys.
Collaborate with the Art and Engineering departments to produce initial artwork and develop production approaches.
Incorporate project scope, pricing parameters, and relevant details into initial proposals or final bids for customer approval.
Establish and update the initial ERP database with project information.

Project Planning

Upon project award, finalize graphic and engineering drawings, product specifications, and project timelines.
Work with Production Control to confirm production schedules and expand the ERP database as needed.
Secure installation drawings from the Art Department and confirm billing and reporting procedures with the customer.
Obtain necessary customer approvals and solicit competitive bids from subcontractors, negotiating installation pricing within budget and gross margin guidelines.

Project Execution

Review preliminary and technical surveys to define specific sign locations and finalize installation plans.
Obtain customer approvals and completion photos for billing, initiate Control Orders, and prepare comprehensive billing packages for Account Manager review.
Monitor accounts receivable, coordinate with Accounting/Credit teams to address delinquencies, and maintain an up-to-date ERP database with all project information.

Additional Duties

Perform other tasks as assigned by management to support overall company objectives and deliver high levels of customer satisfaction.

Qualifications

Skills and Competencies

Proficiency in English (reading, writing, speaking) is required; additional language skills are advantageous.
Ability to read, interpret, and communicate complex technical documents, business reports, and industry regulations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present information to managers, customers, and the public.
Solid mathematical skills, including geometry, trigonometry, fractions, percentages, ratios, and basic statistical concepts.
Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook) and experience using database and spreadsheet applications. Familiarity with computer-based project tracking tools is highly preferred.
Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills with a focus on detail, accuracy, and meeting deadlines.

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education and experience required, preferably in Business, Project Management, Engineering, Architecture, or Design.
1-3 years of project management experience in a multi-state or regional environment is required; experience in sign manufacturing, construction trades, or related industries is highly preferred.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams (Project Management, Sales, Production, Finance/Accounting, MIS) and external subcontractors.

Physical and Mental Demands

Primarily an office-based role with typical office duties (sitting, standing, walking, typing, filing).
Ability to lift packages up to 25 pounds occasionally.

Working Conditions

The primary work environment is a general office setting with moderate noise levels.
Some travel may be required to customer sites or installation locations, which may involve overnight stays and varying environmental conditions.

Why Work With Us

Supportive & Friendly Culture
Manage national accounts for Fortune 500 companies
Medical, Dental, Vision coverage options
Flexible Spending & Health Savings Accounts
Company paid Life Insurance
401k with Employer Contribution
Company paid Short/Long Term Disability
Generous Paid Time Off program + Holidays
Career Growth Opportunities and Career Mapping
Additional perks including Pet Insurance, Employee Assistance Program, Educational Assistance Program, Identity Theft Protection, Critical Illness Plans, Commuter Benefits and various employee discount offerings from our Vendors

Pay Range

$55,000- $70,000 annually - Pay range listed reflects the potential pay for this role. The pay will depend on various factors, such as responsibilities of the position, job duties/requirements, and relevant experience and skills. Not all positions posted will have a pay range listed.

Project Manager - Commercial Doors - Remote 

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead commercial door and hardware projects from pre-construction through closeout. The role focuses on delivering Division 8 scope on time, on budget, and to specification while coordinating with owners, general contractors, vendors, and field teams. The ideal candidate combines technical knowledge of commercial doors, frames, and hardware with strong project management skills and familiarity with industry tools such as Comsense, DFH, and DOORS.

Key Responsibilities

Manage full project lifecycle for commercial door and hardware work, including planning, scheduling, budgeting, procurement, installation oversight, commissioning, and closeout.
Serve as primary client and general contractor contact for assigned projects; maintain timely, professional communication and manage expectations.
Develop and maintain project schedules, track milestones, and coordinate sequencing with trades to minimize delays and disruptions.
Prepare and review submittals, shop drawings, RFIs, and change orders; ensure compliance with Division 8 specifications and contract documents.

Manage subcontractors and installers, including scope definition, performance monitoring, and payment processing.
Lead project closeout activities: final inspections, punch lists, warranty documentation, as-builts, and client turnover.
Maintain safety and quality standards on all projects, promote a culture of continuous improvement, and ensure compliance with company policies and OSHA regulations.

Qualifications

Minimum 5 years of project management experience in commercial doors, frames, and hardware (Division 8) or related scope.
Proven familiarity with Comsense estimating/project management software and experience with DFH processes; experience with Avaware or similar doors-specific software(Comsense, E/pws, Software for Hardware, Pro Tech).

jobs.description:
We seek to move the world forward through innovative thinking.

Woolpert is an award-winning, global leader in architecture, engineering, and geospatial services. We blend design excellence with cutting-edge technology to deliver exceptional client value. Our team is passionate about their work and committed to building the next generation of industry leaders, and as a certified Great Place to Work®, Woolpert embraces progress and innovation to create limitless opportunities for career growth.

Position Overview

Woolpert is hiring an Aviation Planning Project Manager to join our dynamic Aviation National team. Our ideal candidate would be an Aviation Planning Project Manager with a broad planning aperture that includes Master Plans, Airport Layout Plans, Site/Facility Plans, research and Statewide Planning Efforts. Additional preferences include experience in emerging technology and polices regarding Advanced Air Mobility (AAM), and other aviation enterprise technology. Our ideal Aviation Project Manager is one that is forward-looking, collaborative, and energized to expand Woolpert’s existing footprint as an emerging industry leader within the established fields of Aviation Planning and AAM as well as other emerging technology niches. Success will be measured by your ability to develop, lead, and manage profitable growth through meaningful client relationships.

We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must already possess work authorization in the country the job is located.

What You Will Do

Advise clients regarding innovative technology and content to help them make better decisions. Recommend relevant strategies and work with customers to prepare implementation and migration strategies.
Advise, author, and guide airport planning and design activities on master plans, airport layout plans, and/or airspace integration initiatives for internal and external clients.
Understand our clients and know their business.
Collaborate closely with the National Aviation Services Operations team and dedicated aviation staff to deliver the practice goals.
Assist in business growth of Aviation Planning, AAM applications, and other consulting services by developing and supporting a pipeline of new and existing business/contract opportunities.
Drive partnerships with other consultants in the aviation industry to win and perform projects.
Develop and maintain industry expertise in emerging technologies and regulations, including partnerships with strategic industry leaders.
Maintain a thought-leader/Subject Matter Expert profile in the industry by preparing related articles and/or speaking at regional conference presentations.
Work with staff to ensure successful project delivery, consistent quality, customer satisfaction, financial performance, and team/office satisfaction.
Manage, monitor, and forecast metrics including: Backlog, Profit and Loss, Sales, Net Revenue, Utilization, Continuing Education, and Non-Billable Travel and Expenses for yourself.
Lead and support where appropriate proposals, shortlist presentations, and white papers for prospective clients and participate in contract negotiations with clients.
Provide quality reviews of project documentation including work plans thru final deliverables.

What You Will Bring

Associate or Bachelor’s degree in a related field or a minimum of 5+ years’ of related work experience.
Aviation Subject Matter Expertise in one or more areas: Airport Layout Plans, Airport Master Plans, instrument approaches, pavements, facility planning studies, or site development.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in a dynamic environment.
Must be willing to travel to clients, conferences and other Woolpert offices.
Demonstrated ability to organize and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
Quickly adapt and respond to industry changes as well as internal initiatives.

Benefits You Will Love

Certified as a Great Place to Work, Woolpert is one of the fastest-growing architecture, engineering, and geospatial companies in the world. With over 75 offices and countless projects around the globe, you’ll work on meaningful assignments that improve quality of life around the world. In addition to offering competitive pay, we provide employees with a robust set of unique benefits, including:

Freedom to Work program: Set your own schedule and location (as appropriate).
Principal program: Earn the opportunity to become an owner of the firm.
Flexible paid time off/vacation: Take time off when it makes sense for you and your team.
Career development: Explore a wide range of learning and growth opportunities within and across industries.
Health, life, vision, and dental insurance: Cover all your medical bases.
Paid sick time, retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, pet insurance, identity protection, technology stipend, employee assistance program, and more!

Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Pay Range

$87,100 - $108,900 USD

Find out more about what Woolpert has to offer here: http://woolpert.com/about-us/

Woolpert is committed to the full inclusion of all individuals. The PM will act as the first point of contact for customers concerning their individual projects as well as ongoing business requirements. An ideal candidate would have experience with direct customer contact, be a problem solver and a track record of navigating through complex projects while creating strong relationships internally and externally. jobs.description:
Sobre o Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina
. Guiados pelo propósito de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram
, criamos tecnologias e soluções que simplificam toda a jornada da moradia, do aluguel à compra e venda.

Presentes em 6 países
(Brasil, México, Argentina, Peru, Equador e Panamá) e com um hub de tecnologia em Portugal
, reunimos mais de 3.100 pessoas no desafio de transformar o setor. Com o apoio de investidores globais como SoftBank, General Atlantic e Kaszek, já captamos mais de US$ 755 milhões
e somos uma empresa avaliada em US$ 5,1 bilhões
.

Lideramos a transformação do mercado sendo pioneiros na aplicação de Inteligência Artificial em larga escala no setor imobiliário. Nossas plataformas somam mais de 50 milhões de acessos mensais, administrando mais de 350 mil contratos de aluguel ativos e movimentando R$ 20 bilhões por ano.

Se você busca resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, tecnologia de ponta e impacto em escala massiva, pode entrar, a casa é sua.

Para saber mais sobre a nossa história, acesse: https://grupoquintoandar.com/

Localização e Modelo de Trabalho

Atuamos no modelo remote-first , oferecendo total flexibilidade para você trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil. Para quem gosta de encontros presenciais, disponibilizamos nosso escritório em São Paulo e coworkings parceiros. Além disso, contamos com o programa Work From Anywhere (WFA), que permite trabalhar remotamente de qualquer lugar do mundo por até 90 dias no ano.

Sobre a Área e o Desafio

Como Gerente de Growth Intelligence, você liderará uma equipe multidisciplinar encarregada de dois pilares centrais: proteger a operação contra perdas financeiras e impulsionar novas frentes de expansão de receita. Na prática, o papel exige equilibrar o rigor analítico para combater ineficiências, má conduta e vazamentos de dados, trabalhando lado a lado com o time de fraude, com a execução estratégica de projetos de alto impacto, como a criação de novos canais de monetização via anúncios ( ads ). Trata-se de uma posição para um líder versátil e analítico, capaz de orquestrar áreas como Produto, Jurídico, Finanças e Operações para construir um ecossistema seguro e escalável.

Responsabilidades:

Prevenção de Perdas e Gestão de Riscos

Detecção e Monitoramento: Identificar e monitorar proativamente anomalias operacionais que abranjam perdas financeiras, vazamento de dados, má conduta de parceiros e problemas de qualidade, construindo, implementando e aprimorando do zero regras de monitoramento automatizadas e alertas baseados em dados.
Gestão de Valor e Impacto: Avaliar e mensurar os potenciais efeitos financeiros e operacionais dos riscos para alinhar e impulsionar iniciativas vitais junto às principais partes interessadas (stakeholders).
Investigação e Gestão de Consequências: Gerenciar canais oficiais de denúncia e programas de conformidade (compliance). Garantir que os casos passem por triagem e investigação qualificadas, aplicando a gestão de consequências adequada (desde bloqueios operacionais e recuperação de receita até treinamentos direcionados aos parceiros).
Definição de Políticas e Melhoria de Processos: Evoluir continuamente as bases estruturais dos nossos programas de qualidade e proteção de dados. Influenciar e colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para moldar políticas relacionadas a programas e incentivos de parceiros, unificando diretrizes em toda a empresa para migrar nossas operações de uma resolução reativa de problemas para uma governança proativa e escalável.

Projetos Estratégicos

Liderança de Projetos Especiais: Identificar, estruturar e liderar iniciativas de alta prioridade de ponta a ponta — do escopo e business case até a execução e entrega —, começando pelo lançamento de novas fontes de receita, como a monetização via anúncios (ads).
Construção Multifuncional: Atuar em parceria com os times de Produto, Tecnologia, Finanças e Negócios para projetar, pilotar e escalar novas iniciativas, traduzindo problemas ambíguos do zero ao um (zero-to-one) em roadmaps estruturados.
Iteração Baseada em Dados: Definir métricas de sucesso e acompanhamento para cada nova iniciativa, utilizando dados para iterar rapidamente e aplicando o mesmo rigor investigativo da prevenção de perdas para validar novas apostas de crescimento antes de escalá-las.

Requisitos:

Experiência relevante com resolução de problemas e extração de insights a partir de dados;
Experiência com estruturação de área;
Experiência em projetos complexos e com necessidade de resolução rápida e eficaz;
Conhecimento em metodologias de projetos;
Experiência com diferentes stakeholders sêniors;
Domínio de ferramentas de processamento de dados para viabilizar análises, como SQL, Google Sheets e modelos de IA.

Diferenciais

Desenhamos uma jornada transparente, direta e focada em avaliar seu potencial técnico, comportamental e oferecer a você a oportunidade de conhecer nossos times e trilhas de carreira, sendo estruturadas da seguinte forma:

na sua caixa de entrada.

Benefícios

Oferecemos um pacote completo focado na sua saúde, bem-estar, família e desenvolvimento:

Remuneração: Salário competitivo, Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR - para funções elegíveis) e Remuneração Variável (para funções elegíveis).
Saúde e Bem-Estar: Plano de Saúde, Odontológico, Seguro de Vida, Wellhub (Gympass) e QuintoCare (apoio psicológico, jurídico, social e financeiro gratuito).

Diversidade & Inclusão no Grupo QuintoAndar

Valorizamos a diversidade
e queremos que todas as pessoas se sintam bem-vindas por aqui
— independentemente da sua idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, cor, etnia, origem, deficiência, religião ou qualquer outra característica. Privacidade e Proteção a Dados

The primary technology ecosystem includes CommerceLayer, Contentful CMS, React/Next.js, and Vercel
.

This is a highly visible delivery leadership role responsible for ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget and scope, with strong technical quality and high client satisfaction
.

Key Technology Environment

CommerceLayer
Contentful CMS
React.js
Next.js
Vercel
Headless / Composable Commerce
Jamstack
REST APIs and third-party integrations
ERP / PIM / payment integrations

Required Experience

Composable eCommerce

5+ years managing complex enterprise eCommerce project lifecycles, including cart and checkout, multi-currency, global taxation, payments, fulfillment, and order management.
3+ years managing projects using CommerceLayer or comparable headless commerce platforms such as commercetools.
Experience managing integrations involving ERP, PIM, payment gateways, inventory, fulfillment, and third-party services.

Headless CMS / Contentful

Experience managing Contentful development, QA, sandbox, and production environments.
Experience with localized content, content workflows, publishing processes, and automated content migrations.

React / Next.js / Vercel

3+ years managing Agile engineering teams delivering applications using React.js and Next.js.
2+ years of experience managing projects hosted and deployed through Vercel.
Working knowledge of modern web application deployment, monitoring, release management, and CI/CD practices.
Understanding of frontend performance, caching, CDN strategies, SSR/ISR, and dynamic rendering concepts.
Ability to identify delivery risks associated with frontend architecture and performance requirements.

Enterprise Client & Stakeholder Management

8+ years serving as a senior client-facing project or delivery leader.
Experience managing enterprise stakeholders, executive sponsors, steering committees, and business leaders.
Proven ability to manage expectations, scope changes, priorities, escalations, and competing stakeholder requirements.
5+ years managing third-party vendors, specialized consulting teams, security partners, and technology platform providers.
Experience working with distributed and geographically diverse teams.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Delivery Management

Own the end-to-end delivery lifecycle for global composable eCommerce and headless web initiatives.
Establish project charters, delivery roadmaps, milestones, release plans, dependencies, and governance structures.
Lead Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
Coordinate cross-functional teams consisting of developers, architects, QA engineers, UX teams, content authors, business analysts, and client stakeholders.
Identify and resolve cross-team dependencies and delivery blockers.
Establish delivery processes that promote predictable execution, quality, and continuous improvement.
Manage release planning across development, QA, UAT, staging, and production environments.

Scope, Budget & Risk Management

Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, resources, and delivery commitments.
Establish and enforce formal change control processes.
Track project financials, resource utilization, burn rates, forecasts, and SOW commitments.
Identify technical, operational, integration, and organizational risks and develop mitigation strategies.
Proactively manage dependencies involving APIs, content models, integrations, platform capabilities, and deployment pipelines.
Escalate critical issues appropriately and drive timely resolution.

Client & Stakeholder Management

Serve as the primary delivery contact for enterprise clients and senior stakeholders.
Conduct regular project status meetings, steering committee reviews, and executive-level reporting.
Provide clear reporting on schedule, budget, scope, risks, issues, dependencies, quality, and overall project health.
Translate complex technical concepts into clear business implications and recommendations.
Manage stakeholder expectations and facilitate decisions when priorities or requirements conflict.
Maintain strong client relationships and drive overall customer satisfaction.

UAT, Quality & Release Management

Lead and govern the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) process.
Coordinate business users, QA teams, developers, and content teams throughout testing cycles.
Track defects, remediation, dependencies, and release readiness.
Monitor production readiness and coordinate deployment activities.
Ensure appropriate documentation, testing evidence, approvals, and release controls are in place.
Drive continuous improvement in delivery quality and defect prevention.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be measured through delivery predictability, financial management, quality, and client satisfaction, including:

On-Time Delivery: Target of 90%+ for committed milestones and sprint objectives.
Budget Management: Maintain project spend within approximately ±5% of approved budgets.
Quality: Maintain low production defect leakage and ensure effective QA/UAT processes.
Client Satisfaction: Maintain 85%+ CSAT through effective communication, transparency, and delivery management.
Delivery Predictability: Maintain stable team velocity and proactively address factors affecting sprint and release commitments.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of overall IT project/program management experience.
8+ years managing complex digital, eCommerce, web application, or composable architecture projects.
Demonstrated experience delivering Headless/Composable eCommerce solutions.
Hands-on project delivery experience with CommerceLayer, Contentful, Next.js, and Vercel, or closely comparable technologies.
Strong understanding of eCommerce architecture, APIs, integrations, CMS platforms, and modern web development.
Strong experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies; experience with Kanban, SAFe, or hybrid delivery models is an asset.
Advanced experience with Jira and Confluence.
Experience with project planning and visualization tools such as MS Project, Smartsheet, Miro, or equivalent platforms.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
Demonstrated ability to lead high-performing, distributed teams in a fast-paced enterprise environment.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage complex delivery issues and escalations.

Certifications

PMP, CSM, Or PSM Certification Is Required.

Additional certifications or training in Contentful, CommerceLayer, cloud technologies, Agile delivery, or digital commerce
are considered an asset.

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, Project Management, or a related discipline
, or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred Experience

Experience with Contentful Certified Professional credentials or equivalent Contentful expertise.
CommerceLayer training, certification, or developer fundamentals exposure.
Experience with commercetools or other headless commerce platforms.
Experience with cloud-based architectures and modern CI/CD practices.
Experience managing ERP, PIM, payment, inventory, fulfillment, and third-party integrations.
Experience with enterprise security, accessibility, performance, and compliance initiatives.
Experience working with external platform partners such as Vercel, Contentful, CommerceLayer, and technology consulting firms.

Technical Project Management | Composable Commerce | Headless eCommerce | Contentful | CommerceLayer | Next.js | React | Vercel | Jamstack | Agile/Scrum | Program Delivery | Client Management | Executive Stakeholder Management | Budget & Resource Management | Risk Management | UAT | Release Management | API Integrations | ERP/PIM Integrations | Vendor Management

Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Job Description

Ares is seeking a Program Manager for our Cybersecurity and Information Technology team. The Program Manager will collaborate with technology and security teams within the organization and will be responsible for managing and reporting on programs to support strategic long-term and short-term goals. The Program Manager will lead project prioritization & coordinate activities between multiple projects to ensure they align with the organization’s business goals and broader objectives.

The ideal candidate will be experienced in identifying critical projects from the various cross functional groups in cybersecurity and technology and be able to collaborate with project managers and leads to onboard and prioritize projects that impact the overall Cybersecurity, IT, and business objectives. The candidate should be well versed in cybersecurity concepts, reporting the program/portfolio status and health, and be able to implement and lead an organized, structured, and scheduled method of communication; reporting necessary updates, reprioritizations, risks, and accomplishments of the core projects within the program.

Reporting relationships

Reports to: PMO lead in COO technology

Understand organization goals and values and organize programs and activities in accordance with the mission and goals of the organization.
Identify and organize priority technology projects from various cross functional groups into a central program.
Prioritize projects within the program with leadership to support the strategic direction and objectives of Cybersecurity, IT, and the Business.
Implement a project review and onboarding process, including an impact analysis and a process to reprioritize projects as needed.
Develop an evaluation method to assess program strengths and identify areas for improvement.
Ensure success and exit criteria are established and appropriate for each project.
Ensure and work with project leaders for reporting on project status, health, risks, issues, and criteria progress.
Implement and manage changes and interventions to ensure project and program goals are achieved.
Produce and communicate accurate and timely reporting of program status throughout its life cycle.
Analyze, summarize, and report on critical program risks to all levels of the organization.
Communicate with stakeholders, transparently and directly reporting project issues and decisions.
Assist and mentor project managers, team leads, and team members within the cybersecurity vertical(s) with project management, planning, and execution related activities.
Create visually empowering documents that drive clear objectives, promote, deliver, and/or confirm goals/objectives.
Work with the CISO on development of cyber maturity strategy, inclusive of development and tracking of remediation and maturity improvement workstreams.
Perform other related duties as needed and assigned.

Bachelor’s degree or master’s degree in a related field
Project Management Professional (PMP) / Program Management Professional (PgMP) certification is a plus
Cybersecurity certifications (i.e. CISSP), a major plus

Experience Required

Proficient knowledge of technology projects and program management concepts, from planning and inception through implementation and support
Experienced in implementing program strategies, oversee collaboration, define success metrices
Excel at Risk and Conflict Management
Experience in developing programs, resource plans, project plans, timelines, and roadmaps
Experience of Agile project management methods and tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet

Experience and a good understanding of the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), and associated controls
Experience with budget planning, tracking, and forecasting

Excellent client-facing and internal communication skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Proactive nature and ability to arrive at resolution with minimal supervision
Solid organizational skills including attention to detail and multitasking skills
Self-motivated with excellent planning, interpersonal, and organizational skills.

Managing Director, COO, Technology

Description

Project Manager, Oncology - Sponsor Dedicated

Syneos Health® is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success. We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities.

Our Clinical Development model brings the customer and the patient to the center of everything that we do. We are continuously looking for ways to simplify and streamline our work to not only make Syneos Health easier to work with, but to make us easier to work for.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to accelerate the delivery of therapies, because we are passionate to change lives.

Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know:

WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

Why Syneos Health

We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.
We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.

Job Responsibilities

Project Leadership and Delivery. Manages a project as a project manager overseeing interdisciplinary clinical research studies and ensures compliance with GCP, relevant SOP’s, and regulatory requirements.
Acts as a primary liaison between the Company and the Customer to ensure timely study launch, conduct, and closeout according to the Customer’s and the Company’s contractual agreement.
Lead project team to ensure quality, timelines and budget management.
Accountable for the financial performance of each project. Coordinate activities and deliverables of all study conduct partners and proactively identify and manage issues.
Ensure studies are conducted in compliance with GCP, relevant SOP’s and regulatory requirements. Accountable for all project deliverables for each project assigned.
Responsible for quality and completeness of TMF for assigned projects.
Accountable for maintenance of study information on a variety of databases and systems.
Responsible for study management components of inspection readiness for all aspects of the study conduct. Oversight for development and implementation of project plans.
Plan, coordinate and present at internal and external meetings. Prepare project management reports for clients and management.
Developing contingency planning and risk mitigation strategies to ensure successful delivery of study goals.
Develops strong relationships with current clients to generate new and/or add-on business for the future.
May participate in bid defense meetings where presented as potential project manager.
May be required to line manage other project management team members and clinical monitoring staff.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) level of qualification in life sciences, Medicine, Pharmacy, Nursing or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Clinical research organization (CRO) and relevant therapeutic experience preferred. Strong knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
Strong organizational skills.
Strong ability to manage time and work independently.
Direct therapeutic area expertise.
Ability to embrace new technologies.
Excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal skills, both written and spoken.
Ability to travel as necessary (approximately 25%).

We are always excited to connect with great talent. This posting is intended for a [possible] upcoming opportunity rather than a live role. By expressing your interest, you'll be added to our talent pipeline and considered should this role become available.

At  Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position may include a company car or car allowance, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, eligibility to participate in Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and individual performance, and flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

Salary Range:

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

http://www.syneoshealth.com

Roles within Clinical Project Management job family are responsible for planning, directing, creating and communicating clinical study time-lines. Gathers input from cross-functional teams and creates plans that help the team produce deliverables on schedule. Ensures consistency of clinical study and processes across clinical trials, overseeing and resolving operational aspects of clinical trials in conjunction with project teams and in accordance with standard operating procedures (SOP), good clinical practice (GCP) and specific country regulations such as site and vendor selection, preparing clinical trial budgets. Ensures studies are conducted within clinical trial protocols, monitoring progress and following up with team members and line managers when issues develop. The majority of time is spent overseeing their area of responsibility, planning, prioritizing, and/or directing the responsibilities of employees. Broad job knowledge in an operational, administrative and/or specialized field, adapts new procedures, techniques, tools, etc. Understands basic management approaches such as work scheduling, prioritizing, coaching and process execution.

jobs.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Austin, TX, USA; New York, NY, USA; San Jose, CA, USA
. Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
8 years of experience in program management.
5 years of experience establishing and driving Business Process Modeling (BPM) and Process Mining programs.
Experience with leading industry Business Process Modeling and Process Mining suites (such as SAP Signavio or Celonis), and Enterprise Architecture platforms (such as LeanIX).

Preferred qualifications:

Experience with cross-functional stakeholder management and technical storytelling to align executive-level technical and business pillars.
Experience operating as a strategic player-coach, shifting between process modeling/tool configuration with engineering teams and high-level strategy mapping with executive leadership.

About The Job

Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You're equally at home explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade-offs in product development with engineers.

Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage projects of various size and scope, identifying future opportunities, improving processes and driving the technical directions of your programs.

We are seeking a visionary, high-impact Enterprise Architect to join the Enterprise Product Strategy and Architecture (EPA) team within Corporate Engineering.

In this role, you will be the pioneering leader responsible for introducing and establishing Business Process Modeling (BPM) and Process Mining capabilities across the organization. Operating as a strategic player-coach, you will hold a vital dual mandate. First, you will partner cross-functionally with all corporate engineering pillars to systematically identify high-impact opportunities for overall process improvement, actively leading and supporting their execution to drive tangible operational gains.

Second, you will serve as the dedicated Enterprise Architecture (EA) Liaison for one or more core business Pillars. In this liaison capacity, you will cover a broad range of EA topics, including defining and driving architectural standards, establishing reusable design patterns, and establishing horizontal alignment.

At Corp Eng, we build world-leading business solutions that scale a more helpful Google for everyone. As Google’s IT organization, we provide end-to-end solutions for organizations across Google. We deliver the right tools, platforms, and experiences for all Googlers as they create more helpful products and services for everyone. In the simplest terms, we are Google for Googlers.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Pioneer, establish, and lead the long-term vision, standards, and governance for introducing Business Process Modeling (BPM) and Process Mining across the organization.
Drive the implementation and adoption of process mining tools (such as SAP Signavio) to automatically discover and analyze operational workflows. Integrate process mining insights with enterprise architecture repositories (such as LeanIX).
Define, track, and drive the objective, quantifiable measurement of process optimization benefits. Translate workflow efficiencies and process improvements into business-friendly Return on Investment (ROI) metrics.
Execute systematic process and asset rationalization strategies to identify and eliminate redundant steps, duplicate systems, and legacy manual workarounds.
Partner with all corporate engineering pillars to systematically identify process inefficiencies and bottlenecks. Lead, support, and actively drive the execution of targeted process improvement initiatives.

Launch team plays a key role in the mission of delivering best in class service to Amazon's customers through scaling and expanding the network. The team coordinates project plans and tracks execution across stakeholders from business, technology, design, procurement and construction teams.

jobs.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Austin, TX, USA; New York, NY, USA; San Jose, CA, USA
. Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
8 years of experience in program management.
5 years of experience establishing and driving Business Process Modeling (BPM) and Process Mining programs.
Experience with leading industry Business Process Modeling and Process Mining suites (such as SAP Signavio or Celonis), and Enterprise Architecture platforms (such as LeanIX).

Preferred qualifications:

Experience with cross-functional stakeholder management and technical storytelling to align executive-level technical and business pillars.
Experience operating as a strategic player-coach, shifting between process modeling/tool configuration with engineering teams and high-level strategy mapping with executive leadership.

About The Job

Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You're equally at home explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade-offs in product development with engineers.

Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage projects of various size and scope, identifying future opportunities, improving processes and driving the technical directions of your programs.

We are seeking a visionary, high-impact Enterprise Architect to join the Enterprise Product Strategy and Architecture (EPA) team within Corporate Engineering.

In this role, you will be the pioneering leader responsible for introducing and establishing Business Process Modeling (BPM) and Process Mining capabilities across the organization. Operating as a strategic player-coach, you will hold a vital dual mandate. First, you will partner cross-functionally with all corporate engineering pillars to systematically identify high-impact opportunities for overall process improvement, actively leading and supporting their execution to drive tangible operational gains.

Second, you will serve as the dedicated Enterprise Architecture (EA) Liaison for one or more core business Pillars. In this liaison capacity, you will cover a broad range of EA topics, including defining and driving architectural standards, establishing reusable design patterns, and establishing horizontal alignment.

At Corp Eng, we build world-leading business solutions that scale a more helpful Google for everyone. As Google’s IT organization, we provide end-to-end solutions for organizations across Google. We deliver the right tools, platforms, and experiences for all Googlers as they create more helpful products and services for everyone. In the simplest terms, we are Google for Googlers.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $192000 - $278000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Pioneer, establish, and lead the long-term vision, standards, and governance for introducing Business Process Modeling (BPM) and Process Mining across the organization.
Drive the implementation and adoption of process mining tools (such as SAP Signavio) to automatically discover and analyze operational workflows. Integrate process mining insights with enterprise architecture repositories (such as LeanIX).
Define, track, and drive the objective, quantifiable measurement of process optimization benefits. Translate workflow efficiencies and process improvements into business-friendly Return on Investment (ROI) metrics.
Execute systematic process and asset rationalization strategies to identify and eliminate redundant steps, duplicate systems, and legacy manual workarounds.
Partner with all corporate engineering pillars to systematically identify process inefficiencies and bottlenecks. Lead, support, and actively drive the execution of targeted process improvement initiatives.

jobs.description:
When applicable, Bombardier promotes flexible and hybrid work policies.

Why join us?

At Bombardier, we design, build and maintain the world’s peak-performing aircraft for the world’s most discerning people and businesses, governments and militaries. We have been successful in setting the highest standards by putting our people at the heart of it all, and defining excellence, together.

Working at Bombardier means operating at the highest level. Every day, you are part of a team that delivers superior experiences and products, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in our industry and beyond. By prioritizing employee growth and development, we empower everyone to reach their full potential on their own terms, because the best work happens when you are free to be yourself and share your unique expertise.

Bombardier’s Benefits Program

With our employees’ well-being top of mind, we offer a comprehensive and competitive Benefits Program, which includes the following:

Insurance plans (Dental, medical, life insurance, disability, and more)
Competitive base salary
Retirement savings plan
Employee Assistance Program
Tele Health Program

What are your contributions to the team?

The Program Management Office (PMO) for Avionics is seeking a highly motivated and results driven programs analyst to join its team. In this role, you will be responsible to drive a portfolio of business-critical projects to successful completion. The selected individual will lead a cross-functional team, including external suppliers, and oversee all aspects of the execution of their projects.

Articulate the goals and objectives of the program, and how it will impact the business;
Own the development and management of the strategies, schedules and budget of your project portfolio;
Establish and track metrics to monitor performance and progress, prepare status reports and modify schedules and plans as required;
Provide day-to-day leadership to cross-functional teams;
Present project schedules, business cases and updates at regular reviews with senior management;
Identify key project risk items, with corresponding risk mitigation or reduction strategies;
Escalate to the appropriate level of management as needed;
Establish and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
Operate within a high-level cross-functional environment, interacting with senior leadership and diverse teams, and play a key influencing role in driving strategic alignment among the functions involved in the program.
Ensure compliance with the Bombardier Engineering System (BES) and the Bombardier Manual (BM) for all product support processes.
Collaborate with the Methods, Logistics, and Quality teams to support program activities.
Provide guidance and mentorship to multidisciplinary teams, including Engineering, Procurement, Planning, and Production.
Support operational, logistics, and planning activities related to the development of flight test and ground test rigs.
Support the development of manufacturing strategies for new products.

How to thrive in this role?

You hold a university degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Engineering, or an equivalent field;
You have a minimum of five (5) to ten (10) years of relevant experience;
You possess excellent communication skills (written and verbal) and are able to influence stakeholders at various levels of the organization;
You have solid experience working in a production/manufacturing environment;
You demonstrate initiative, are results-oriented, and have a strong desire to contribute to the success of Bombardier’s Program Management Office;
You have strong knowledge of aerospace testing and certification processes;
You are organized, self-motivated, and possess strong leadership skills;
You are proficient in MS Office, Teams, Excel, and PowerPoint, with knowledge of database management;
You have experience using and understanding ERP systems (SAP is considered an asset);
You are bilingual (French and English) and demonstrate strong communication skills.

Now that you can see yourself in this role, apply and join the Bombardier Team!

Please note: You don’t need all the skills, knowledge, and experience listed to apply for this position. We’re not looking for the perfect candidate, we’re looking for great talent and passionate individuals.

Bombardier is an equal opportunity employer and encourages persons of any race, religion, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, immigration status, disability or other applicable legally protected characteristics to apply.

jobs.description:
Senior Program Manager, HR Systems Transformation

Program / Scrum Master — Enterprise HR Technology Consolidation

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized, senior-level Program Manager to lead a major enterprise initiative centralizing 4–5 core systems across a global organization. This program touches 80+ areas and groups, spanning funding, network, HR systems, privacy, modeling, and remittance functions. The team today operates as independent regional workstreams; this role exists to unify those workstreams, drive consistency, and instill program-wide discipline. HR is the primary stakeholder for this initiative.
This is not a role for someone who waits to be directed. You will come in with a point of view, immediately establish structure, and hold a global set of stakeholders accountable to it.

What You'll Do

Bring together historically siloed regional workstreams and create a consistent operating rhythm across the program.
Coordinate regional remits across a global organization, ensuring alignment between local execution and program-wide goals.
Manage and coordinate the Steering Group(s) and approximately 5 working groups, including agendas, materials, and follow-through.
Own governance: documentation, action items, dependencies, decisions, and overall program structure.
Ensure JIRA is consistently updated, well-documented, and maintained as the single source of truth for program status.
Take ownership of accountability across teams — proactively identify what's falling through the cracks and close the gap.
Partner closely with senior stakeholders, including HR leadership, presenting status, risks, and decisions clearly and credibly.
Apply Agile methodology and rigor to a large-scale enterprise implementation with many concurrent, interdependent workstreams.

What We're Looking For

Strong Program/Project Management and Scrum Master experience, ideally in a hybrid capacity.
Proven experience on a large-scale enterprise or global system implementation, with an understanding of the complexity involved.
Deep working expertise in JIRA and Agile methodologies.
HR transformation or HR technology experience strongly relevant; exposure to systems such as SuccessFactors, ADP, and/or Qualtrics is a plus.
Experience establishing governance frameworks, steering committees, and working groups from the ground up.
Track record managing global and regional stakeholders, including at senior/executive levels.
Exceptionally organized, detail-oriented, and proactive — comfortable holding others accountable without being asked.
Polished communication style; equally effective in a working session and in front of senior leadership.

jobs.title: 21244 - Engineering Program Manager Traffic
jobs.description:
Job Description

Provider leadership, direction, and technical engineering guidance to related program areas. Serve as statewide resource for transportation safety and program management of Highway Safety Improvement Program. Provide significant impact to protection of public health through the reduction of fatalities and injuries from motor vehicles statewide. Provide staffing levels and training to identify and produce quality transportation safety projects. Monitor HSIP funds, training, safety analysis, and crash data reporting to internal and external customers. Manage transportation safety programs that address all aspects of construction and maintenance work areas, highway safety and railroad crossings. Evaluate current statewide safety programs and policies and identify ways to improve. Work closely with districts, regions, and local jurisdictions to promote safety programs and to provide support in developing safety programs. Manage special safety and research studies.

How You Will Contribute

Compliance: Provide oversight of the program area within the Division and Districts to ensure compliance with VDOT, state, and federal policies, practices, guidelines and specifications. Review central office and district plans for compliance with established practices and procedures. Provide review and make recommendations on new and innovative procedures, specifications and products. Provide a written summary of findings and recommendations for division management.
Data Improvement: Manage and assist in continuing to improve performance and usefulness of established data programs in division including the Traffic Monitoring System, Crash Records System, and others. Continue to enhance the availability of valuable engineering data to potential users.
Establish Priorities: Establish objectives and priorities for the team in support of overall goals, communicate objectives and priorities to employees, and update objectives as needs change. Establish priorities for the program's objectives to enhance achievement of division and VDOT goals. Modify objectives to reflect changes.
Manage Technical Problem Resolution: Apply sound engineering practices and methods to satisfy customers, reduce complaints and resolve concerns. Provide leadership in technical areas of engineering. Proactively address issues that are identified within program area and raise appropriate issues to Division Management ensuring compliance with VDOT policies and procedures.
Network Performance Measures: Manage program responsible for the development and implementation of highway network performance measures using assigned staff, analysis of customer requirements and statistical principles.
Program Evaluation: Evaluate program and institute changes and procedures as required. Provide technical guidance to field offices and monitor adherence to approve standards and practices through field coordination, visitation and consultation. Ensure quality control reviews are completed and recommendations for program performance and improvement are implemented.
Staffing and Management: Proactively manage human and fiscal resources by recognizing future needs and taking appropriate actions to address those needs. Organize program area's assignments to best utilize available resources. Ensure production schedules and budgets continuously reflect current information.
Statewide Program Oversight: Serves as responsible charge engineer for designated program area. Develop and update policies, procedures and guidelines for statewide implementation and administration. Communicate changes in policies and procedures to staff and ensure consistent application statewide.
Strategic Planning: Develop short and long-range statewide strategic plans to ensure VDOT programs align with VDOT's vision, mission and goals.
Teamwork: Coordinate the flow of information both orally and in writing to and from others that contributes to project development. Organize and prioritize work effectively, keep multiple projects on schedule within section. Meet expectations and requirements of internal and external customers. Establish and maintain effective relationships with customers.
Technical Support: Serve as a technical expert in providing assistance in assigned areas of transportation engineering. Provide research to solve problems and questions. Provide instruction and guidance with policies and procedures. Prepare new VDOT guidelines or memos to address changes or modifications.
Traffic Data: Provide data support for the assessment of maintenance needs for traffic engineering assets. Databases are developed and updated as needed to use in estimating maintenance needs.
Traffic Engineering Data Source Management: Manage program responsible for the design, development, and exploitation of traffic engineering data sources to provide valuable engineering data throughout VDOT and to external users. Work with data administration groups to develop and enforce effective standards of mobility management data design using established data modeling standards, guidelines, and policies. Enhance availability of quality mobility management information. Use VDOT Intranet to provide available mobility management data across VDOT. Ensure appropriate traffic engineering data is developed and made available to public affairs for distribution to the Intranet.
Traffic Engineering Technical Support: Provide oversight to the inventory of roadway and roadside safety items for modification or replacement by projects or inquiry by others. Manage and lead development of final pavement marking, pavement marker, sign plans and other traffic control device plans. Provide guidance on placement, installation, functionality and condition of signs, markings, markers, roadside barriers and others.

What Will Make You Successful

Ability to analyze large quantities of complex data.
Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing with diverse audiences and to make presentations and prepare reports.
Ability to conduct the administrative and technical operations of the assigned engineering program area.
Ability to develop effective working relationships at all organizational levels with internal and external customers.
Ability to interpret, apply, and provide guidance on policy and procedures related to program areas.
Ability to manage an engineering program, manage multiple work teams of professional engineering and technical staff, and oversee complex engineering projects.
Ability to manage multiple and complex statewide programs and projects.
Ability to plan and schedule work effectively.
Ability to supervise, coach and train others.
Ability to supervise, coach, train and develop staff.
Demonstrated leadership and consultation skills working with all levels of management, stakeholders, and contractors.
Knowledge of supervisory principles and practices to include hiring, discipline, performance management, and employee development.
Knowledge of traffic engineering analysis practices and related software, including safety and capacity analysis tools such as Synchro, CORSIM, VISSIM and HCS.
Knowledge of traffic engineering principles, practices and procedures, particularly traffic flow theory.
Skill in analyzing and prioritizing tasks and assignments to appropriately manage resources and responsibilities.
Skill in the use of computers and software applications including engineering software and Microsoft Office Suite.
Skill in the use of computers and software applications to include traffic engineering software.

Minimum Qualifications

Ability to analyze large quantities of complex data and to manage multiple, complex statewide programs.
Ability to develop effective relationships at all organizational levels.
Degree in Civil Engineering or related field.
Experience applying supervisory and human resources practices and principles to include hiring, discipline, performance management and employee development.
Experience in the use of computers and software applications to include traffic engineering software.
Experience in traffic engineering analysis practices and related software.
Experience in traffic engineering principles, practices and procedures, particularly traffic flow theory.
Valid Professional Engineer's license.

Additional Considerations

Experience in policy development, interpretation, and analysis.
Experience in the design of complex relational databases and in the operation of technological solutions.
Experience in traffic engineering and traffic control devices, including senior-level management experience, completion of studies, report writing, supervising and training others.
Experience in traffic engineering, especially micro-simulation.
Experience with the development and implementation of transportation performance measures and transportation improvement projects.
Progressively responsible professional engineering experience related to project management and delivery. Managerial level experience leading professional engineering staff.

Do you want to develop security at one of Sweden’s most high-tech companies? Security is prioritized, on top management’s agenda and crucial for competitiveness, profitability and trust in a challenging global market.

Your role

Saab Group Security is looking for a Country Security Manager for a high-risk country.

As Country Security Manager at Group Security, you will work in an international environment where advanced security threats are part of everyday business alongside complex business environments and projects with high business impact.

Your responsibility will be to manage security in all domains including supporting, analyzing, and setting requirements regarding compliance against internal- and external regulations. You will be a key stakeholder for Saab travel within your area of responsibilities and coordinate all security work for this.

You will report to the Deputy Chief Security Officer at Saab. Your primary location is to be decided; you will have to be able to attend meetings in Stockholm and other locations in Sweden frequently and sometime on short notice.

Your main tasks will be:

Security in all aspects of information-, personnel- and physical security
Lead and coordinate Saab security for travel in the region
Risk management, including risk assessments
Incident- and crisis management
Compliance management
Teaching, training and presentations
Liaison with internal and external parties

Your profile

To be successful in this role, you bring

Experience working in or with to high-risk environments
Experience of developing risk mitigating actions and protocols
Experience of producing SOP or other steering documents
Willingness and ability to travel, both to high-risk environments and within Sweden, sometimes on short notice
Good communication skills in Swedish and English, verbal and written

Desired skills:

Experience from working in a global company including understanding of security related issues in the business process and/or in an international context for government authorities
Experience of building and maintaining networks and relations inside as well as outside your own organization

You are a true team player, always focusing on the team's results. You are comfortable working in teams as well as on your own and working in a fast-changing environment. You are flexible and pragmatic but also well-grounded in your decisions.

Personal qualities will be of the outmost importance, and it is paramount that you are trustworthy with strong ethics and high personal integrity.

You understand the need for balanced security in a business-driven environment. As Country Security Manager at Saab, you are likely to get in contact with confidential or classified information.

This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.

What you will be a part of

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.

Saab is a leading defence and security company with an enduring mission, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 26,100 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.

Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defence capability of several nations. Read more about us here

We are a global company and we work in an international context, which will require some travelling both domestic and internationally and you need to feel confident in both speaking and writing in English.

Kindly observe that this is an ongoing recruitment process and that the position might be filled before the closing date of the advertisement.

If you aspire to help create and innovate whilst developing yourself in a challenging team setting, Saab may well have the perfect conditions for you to grow. We pride ourselves on a nurturing environment, where everyone is different, yet we share the same goal – to help protect people.
